response.overview: The company Think Pink emerges as a shining star in the Swedish waste industry during the 2010s. But it will soon find itself at the center of one of Sweden's biggest environmental scandals. The trial of the eleven defendants will conclude in May 2025 after almost 90 days of hearings and 50,000 pages of preliminary investigation. This short documentary contains excerpts from the news reporting and the subsequent legal process.
response.title: Sopskandalen Think Pink
